Very good food, small portions
Apr 2024 • Family
Very good food in a pleasant atmosphere. We didn't want to go in at first because there was no one in the restaurant, but the restaurant across the street was full. We usually always wait until a table becomes available in the "busy" restaurant. But there were 6 of us, so we went to Bo. The waitress was very friendly and spoke good English. She also had a few recommendations for those of us who were undecided. The drinks and the food came very quickly. Everything looked very lovingly prepared and tasted that way too. The portions aren't very big, but they are very tasty! Certainly not mass processing. Although there were no tables left in "Bo" when we left.
